title: Virtual Home Scavenger Hunt
includes: Remote interactive live guide (Must provide domestic phone or WhatsApp number)
Choice to extend the hunt for free
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join Alley Kat Adventures for a unique chance to unleash your boundless creativity, connect virtually yet face to face with loved ones or strangers-turned-friends, and enjoy the personalized attention of your own live Adventure Coach, who will lead you via Zoom on a wild ride that pushes your limits & makes you feel like a rockstar! 

Kat Nelson is the founder and artistic director of Alley Kat Adventures, an Austin-based event design company with a presence in 30 cities in the US & Mexico. She has hand-crafted epic adventures for Google, Intel, Airbnb, Dell, Rice University, etc. Originally from the Carolinas, Kat is naturally hospitable! She has a background as a trade show associate/presenter & a SAG actress with principal TV, film & commercial/print credits. She is also a former teacher (14 years) with a MED and a National Board certification. Prior to launching her own business, Kat led national marketing teams for Facebook, NVIDIA, Avid, etc. Alley Kat Adventures welcomes you!
